spec.description: Official dashboard for Traefik on Kubernetes

spec.expr:
sum by (external_ip) (
  count_over_time({service_name="traefik"} | json | logfmt | drop __error__, __error_details__ 
  | ServiceName=~"$service@.*"
  | request_Cf_Connecting_Ip!="" OR request_X_Real_Ip!=""
  | label_format external_ip="{{if .request_Cf_Connecting_Ip}}{{.request_Cf_Connecting_Ip}}{{else}}{{.request_X_Real_Ip}}{{end}}"
  | external_ip!~"10.2.*" | external_ip!="" [$__auto])
)

topk(10,
  sum by (external_ip) (
    count_over_time({service_name="traefik"} | json | logfmt | drop __error__, __error_details__
    | ServiceName=~"$service@.*"
    | request_Cf_Connecting_Ip!="" OR request_X_Real_Ip!=""
    | label_format external_ip="{{if .request_Cf_Connecting_Ip}}{{.request_Cf_Connecting_Ip}}{{else}}{{.request_X_Real_Ip}}{{end}}"
    | label_format country="{{if .request_Cf_Ipcountry}}{{.request_Cf_Ipcountry}}{{else}}-{{end}}"
    | external_ip!=""
    | external_ip!~"10\\..*|172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\\..*|192\\.168\\..*"
    | keep external_ip [$__auto])
  )
)

spec.description:
Client IP taken from request_Cf_Connecting_Ip, falling back to request_X_Real_Ip.

Private ranges (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16) are excluded, so this is external traffic only.

Top 10 IPs per time bucket.
spec.title: Requests per client IP

spec.expr:
topk(20,
  sum by (external_ip, country) (
    count_over_time({service_name="traefik"} | json | logfmt | drop __error__, __error_details__
    | ServiceName=~"$service@.*"
    | request_Cf_Connecting_Ip!="" OR request_X_Real_Ip!=""
    | label_format external_ip="{{if .request_Cf_Connecting_Ip}}{{.request_Cf_Connecting_Ip}}{{else}}{{.request_X_Real_Ip}}{{end}}"
    | label_format country="{{if .request_Cf_Ipcountry}}{{.request_Cf_Ipcountry}}{{else}}-{{end}}"
    | external_ip!=""
    | external_ip!~"10\\..*|172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\\..*|192\\.168\\..*"
    | keep external_ip, country [$__range])
  )
)

spec.description:
Client IP taken from request_Cf_Connecting_Ip, falling back to request_X_Real_Ip.

Private ranges (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16) are excluded, so this is external traffic only.

Country comes from request_Cf_Ipcountry ('-' when the request did not pass Cloudflare).
spec.title: Top client IPs

spec.expr:
topk(30,
  sum by (request_User_Agent) (
    count_over_time({service_name="traefik"} | json | logfmt | drop __error__, __error_details__
    | ServiceName=~"$service@.*"
    | request_Cf_Connecting_Ip!="" OR request_X_Real_Ip!=""
    | label_format external_ip="{{if .request_Cf_Connecting_Ip}}{{.request_Cf_Connecting_Ip}}{{else}}{{.request_X_Real_Ip}}{{end}}"
    | label_format country="{{if .request_Cf_Ipcountry}}{{.request_Cf_Ipcountry}}{{else}}-{{end}}"
    | external_ip!=""
    | external_ip!~"10\\..*|172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\\..*|192\\.168\\..*"
    | request_User_Agent!=""
    | keep request_User_Agent [$__range])
  )
)
